part_number.product: SEL-2743 Ethernet Switch (managed RSTP / OT SDN switch)
part_number.note: No per-digit Model Option Table (MOT) digit template could be resolved, and no instruction manual, ordering document, or drawing layers for this model are present locally. The SEL-2743 is a configurable managed Ethernet switch ordered through SEL's online Model Option Table configurator; no genuine part number was available to calibrate against, so no positions are asserted to avoid inventing them. Ordering dimensions per the SEL product page: Ethernet Switching Technology RSTP or OT SDN; dual integrated power supplies with input range 12-250 V; various SFP transceiver port options; DIN-rail or surface mounting. The SEL-2743 is positioned as the economical member of the newer SEL-2743/SEL-2744 managed-switch family.
